descriptionChirho: A person or behavior serving as a moral pattern or example to be imitated (Phil 3:17, 1 Thes 1:7, 2 Thes 3:9, 1 Tim 4:12, Tit 2:7, 1 Pet 5:3), including plural and adverbial (τυπικῶς) forms (1 Cor 10:6, 10:11).
A model or design shown as a template for construction, specifically the divinely revealed pattern of the tabernacle (Acts 7:44, Heb 8:5).
A physical mark or imprint left by an object, such as the nail marks in Jesus' hands (John 20:25).
The form, pattern, or template of something written or taught, such as the form of a letter (Acts 23:25) or the pattern of teaching (Rom 6:17).
A crafted representation or image used in idolatrous worship (Acts 7:43, images of pagan gods).
A person or event in salvation history that foreshadows or prefigures a later fulfillment, specifically Adam as a type of Christ (Rom 5:14).
